training_data.sources: Roboflow: 5 species datasets + boar + bird (wildlife, train+valid+test all pooled), Forest scenery dataset + AMMonitor real camera-trap empties (~1000 images) + corrected null-labeled images (non_wildlife)

training_details.stopped_reason: Early stopping - no val_loss improvement for 15 epochs

results.external_sanity_test: 8/10 correct on unfamiliar images (up from 6/10 in v1); non_wildlife recall improved from 20% to 60%

improvements_over_v1: Diversified non_wildlife sources beyond single Forest dataset (added real camera-trap blanks from AMMonitor)
Corrected mislabeled null/blank images that were sitting in wildlife class (elephant, boar, bird)
Included Roboflow valid+test splits, not just train, for more total data
Proper 3-way train/val/test split instead of train/val only, giving an honest held-out test metric
Added early stopping to avoid unnecessary training / overfitting risk
known_issues: Still misclassifies 2/10 external sanity images (both non_wildlife predicted as wildlife) - further investigation needed into what visual pattern is driving this
next_steps: Investigate remaining misclassified images, consider further non_wildlife diversification (e.g. more geographic/lighting variety) for v3
